text_block_list.name: ST-2 (Satie)
text_block_list.text:
*pant*, *pant*... The time isn't bad.
But still――it's not enough yet.

text_block_list.name: ST-2 (Satie)
text_block_list.text: One more! Haaahh!!
choice_data_list: You're really fired up, Dr. Wrights...!
You're really fired up, Dr. Wrights...!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Ever since ST-2 upgraded to its final form,
Dr. Wright's passion for the research has grown even stronger.

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
Hmm, we've conducted repeated tests in the final configuration,
but numerically... things seem rather stagnant.

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
No, it's just that...
I can't tell what's causing this plateau...

text_block_list.name: ST-2 (Satie)
text_block_list.text:
Damn it... Dammit... Why...?
I don't understand. Why is this happening...?!

text_block_list.name: ST-2 (Satie)
text_block_list.text:
Trainer... Indeed, my apologies.
I must ask to borrow everyone's wisdom once more...

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text:
What's missing is,
I think, the power to push hard at the very end.

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text:
I don't know much about robots,
but maybe if we use the emergency booster...

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
No, that would ruin the feel of running.
As I thought, raising the average power output is the way to go...

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text:
"I told you the hardware is at its limit.
Rather than that, focus on upgrading
the 'software'..."

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Though they brought together various opinions,
there was no ray of hope in sight.
Is there really any way to improve things?

text_block_list.name: Tanino Gimlet
text_block_list.text:
Princess of the Wheel, show it to me once more.
The supreme run that you are capable of right now.

text_block_list.name: Sugar Lights
text_block_list.text: Yeah, got it.

text_block_list.name: ST-2 (Satie)
text_block_list.text: Haaaaaaah!

text_block_list.name: Symboli Kris S
text_block_list.text: She's getting faster—by far.

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text: Yeah, if I can run this well...

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text:
Cramming at the last second ain't gonna cut it.
Throwing in random stuff will only make things worse.

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text: Then what should we do...?

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Only Tanino Gimlet remained silent.
She simply stared intently at ST-2, and then...

text_block_list.name: Tanino Gimlet
text_block_list.text: It's... a tin can.

text_block_list.name: Tanino Gimlet
text_block_list.text:
It is still a tin can. On the outside,
it is polished like a flawless statue. However—

text_block_list.name: Tanino Gimlet
text_block_list.text:
Far from the Deus Ex Machina.
In that case—

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: (Flap)

text_block_list.name: Tanino Gimlet
text_block_list.text:
I shall reveal the answer to you.
Me, myself—no, I will.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Kris S
text_block_list.text: Gimlet, are you planning... to match paces with me?

text_block_list.name: ST-2 (Satie)
text_block_list.text:
"Tanino Gimlet...
Are you saying you know?
What it is that I lack."

text_block_list.name: Tanino Gimlet
text_block_list.text:
Indeed. But before that...
The pacesetter and Taishin—step forward.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: ...Called over by Tanino Gimlet, the three of us first held a brief strategy meeting on how to coordinate our tandem run.

text_block_list.name: Tanino Gimlet
text_block_list.text:
“—And that's how it is.
Me and the Doctor will run first, and then—”

text_block_list.name: Tanino Gimlet
text_block_list.text:
I shall entrust the horn to the vanguard.
When the time comes to advance, blow it.

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text: ...Understood on my end, too.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: And so, first up—ST-2 and Tanino Gimlet were to run together.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: I had Narita Taishin wait by the side of the course.

text_block_list.name: Gimlet & ST-2
text_block_list.text:
Haaaaaah!
Taaaaaaah!

text_block_list.name: Tanino Gimlet
text_block_list.text:
Heh, you've improved, tin can.
However—you're still nowhere close.

text_block_list.name: ST-2 (Satie)
text_block_list.text:
"Do not underestimate it. The current ST-2
is no longer the incomplete form it was at first."

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
The speed hardly changed at all.
Quite surprising.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Kris S
text_block_list.text:
Yeah. But—
a race is not a contest... of speed.

text_block_list.name: Gimlet & ST-2
text_block_list.text:
Haaaaaaah!
Woooooooah!

text_block_list.name: Tanino Gimlet
text_block_list.text: RAAAAAAAAGH!

text_block_list.name: ST-2 (Satie)
text_block_list.text:
Ugh... guh...!?
Little by little... the gap is...

text_block_list.name: Tanino Gimlet
text_block_list.text:
"Is this all you've got, tin can?
Will you be swallowed helplessly into the muddy sea of reason?"

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
"At this rate, ST-2 will
definitely be left behind. In that case—"

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text: Yeah! Haaaaaaah!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
—Without missing a beat, Narita Taishin was sent in.
To chase after them.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: Narita Taishin caught up in an instant, and then—

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text: Yaaaaaahhhhh!!

text_block_list.name: ST-2 (Satie)
text_block_list.text:
――!? Taishin!?
She's making a move... on the final stretch!?

text_block_list.name: ST-2 (Satie)
text_block_list.text:
This off-the-charts speed...
No, it isn't speed.
What is completely different between us is...

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text: I used up my burst of speed to catch up. But if it comes down to a battle in the final stretch—

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text:
I... won't lose!
There's no way in hell I'm losinggg!!!!

text_block_list.name: ST-2 (Satie)
text_block_list.text: This "fighting spirit" is...ible?!

text_block_list.name: ST-2 (Satie)
text_block_list.text:
(The fundamental... quality is different...
Fundamentally different from ST-2's running...)

text_block_list.name: ST-2 (Satie)
text_block_list.text:
(I am merely, so to speak, "riding in a vehicle."
Taishin, however...)

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text: Uwaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaahhh!!

text_block_list.name: ST-2 (Satie)
text_block_list.text:
(...It's her spirit.
Her raw feelings are turning directly into her running!)

text_block_list.name: ST-2 (Satie)
text_block_list.text:
(Unless I reach this state of mind...
there's no way I can overcome the wall.)

text_block_list.name: Tanino Gimlet
text_block_list.text:
"Yes, the crucial passion isn't found in a tin body.
The one who possesses it is—"

text_block_list.name: Tanino Gimlet
text_block_list.text: It's you, Princess of the Wheel!

text_block_list.name: Tanino Gimlet
text_block_list.text:
If you wish to fly—tear them to pieces.
The chains of the bound princess that shackle your heart.

text_block_list.name: Sugar Lights
text_block_list.text:
Right... Until now, I tried
to run purely on logic. But...

text_block_list.name: Sugar Lights
text_block_list.text: For ST-2 to truly run on equal footing with an Umamusume—

text_block_list.name: Sugar Lights
text_block_list.text: Reason alone... won't be enough to reach it.

text_block_list.name: Sugar Lights
text_block_list.text: Running with all your heart, and answering their feelings in kind—that's what it's all about!

text_block_list.name: ST-2 (Satie)
text_block_list.text: WOOOOOOOOOOOOOOOOOOOOOOOOO!

text_block_list.name: Tanino Gimlet
text_block_list.text: Heh—so you've awakened.

text_block_list.name: ST-2 (Satie)
text_block_list.text:
"I waaaant to...
I want to... follow my heart eveeeen moreee!!"

text_block_list.name: Symboli Kris S
text_block_list.text: Hmm, it has changed――your running style.

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text: Damn, it surpassed it... beyond all numerical limits...

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
"I suppose this was inevitable. When an earnest Taishin
comes chasing after you, you have no choice but to end up like this..."

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text: Truly a small bullet. Driven by that fierce late surge with everything staked on the line, how could anyone not be fired up?

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
"Chased by that heat, both Ticket and I grew stronger.
And now... the Doctor has too."

text_block_list.name: Symboli Kris S
text_block_list.text:
Hm.
ST-2 is no longer... a machine.
Yes—

text_block_list.name: Symboli Kris S
text_block_list.text: She's a real Umamusume.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
And so, running alongside Tanino Gimlet
and Narita Taishin, ST-2 demonstrated
an unprecedented level of explosive power.

text_block_list.name: ST-2 (Satie)
text_block_list.text:
Haa, haa, haa. In the end, I couldn't win.
However...!

text_block_list.name: ST-2 (Satie)
text_block_list.text:
"The lubricant is... running hot.
Is this what ST-2 is like?"

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
I see... Watching that tandem gallop just now
allowed me to clearly analyze the root cause.

text_block_list.name: ST-2 (Satie)
text_block_list.text: Hmm, could it be... that this isn't just a matter of mindset?

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text: To put it crudely, yes... but more precisely—

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text: The Doctor was still trying to maintain "control."

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
Up until now, I consciously tried to move my prosthetic body,
ST-2. However—

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
Neither Umamusume nor humans consciously
think about how to walk or run.

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
Every movement is "unconscious."
That's precisely why her reactions are so fast, and her room for growth so vast...

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
"What the Doctor lacked was trust in ST-2,
and surrendering to instinct."

text_block_list.name: ST-2 (Satie)
text_block_list.text:
I see... Instinct...
So that's the reason...

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
Having Taishin be the one to give chase was also optimal.
On the final stretch, she always runs on pure instinct.

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
The Doctor must have been inspired by that instinct as well.
The timing of her order to pursue was impeccable.
choice_data_list: Well... there really wasn't anywhere else, was there?
Well... there really wasn't anywhere else, right?

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
If we were to make them give chase, it had to be when Dr. Wrights was on the verge of giving up.
There was no hesitation in our decision.

text_block_list.name: Tanino Gimlet
text_block_list.text:
Heh, thus—it seems the forbidden gate
has opened. In that case—

text_block_list.name: Tanino Gimlet
text_block_list.text:
Let us go.
To the edge of the horizon, and beyond.
